translation_notes: The notebook parses "../rdf/example3.rdf", a file not shipped with the extracted region; original.py and translated.ldpy both load fixture.ttl instead (module-level exec, executability edit only, per AGENT_BATCH.md).

fixture.ttl is a real graph (john/jane/bob/carol) exercising all 5 queries, including the foaf:knows join of q5 and a non-matching neighbour (ex:carol): this is not a hollow-graph pass, module-level stdout differs whenever a query result differs.

q3 and q5 bind ?Family / ?JaneSmithFullName via initBindings, but neither variable is projected: per the bind_initbindings rule the bound value is written directly as a typed literal term in the pattern ("Smith"^^xsd:string, "Jane Smith"^^xsd:string) instead of passed as a binding.

prepareQuery(...) + g.query(query, initNs=...) becomes s{ } bound once and called on the graph (q1(g), ...); no s{ } was needed where m{ } would have sufficed, since every query here is a genuine SELECT the module treats as a query object, matching the sparql_literal stratum.

VCARD.Given is printed as a plain Python value outside any island in q5's last line, so @prefix vcard: <...> as VCARD binds the Namespace object for that use; the other prefixes (xsd, foaf) are only ever used inside islands and need no 'as' binding.
